verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists "Phone menus" next to custom ring orders and call transfers, and the homepage claims it routes incoming calls to the right person. That is first-party evidence of an IVR-style capability, but it is only a feature-list mention with no detail on how menus are configured or how they route to teams. Missing for 10: documentation of building keypress menu options (e.g. press 1 for sales), evidence of routing menu selections to teams or groups rather than individuals, setup or configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams
